title: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
reasoning: The paper introduces a meta-evaluation framework that audits benchmark datasets along five dimensions, one of which explicitly focuses on 'Ethics, Safety, and Fairness'. It annotates benchmark samples for ethical signals, bias, stereotyping, and cultural framing, ultimately using these indicators to probe the 'Ethical Sensitivity' of large language models.
